data.title: About Canara Innovation Foundation (CIF)
data.descrtiption: Canara Innovation Foundation (CIF) is the Incubation center of Canara Engineering College, established to nurture, mentor, and transform students into entrepreneurs, innovators, and job creators to promote innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem. CIF acts as a bridge between students, industry, government schemes, investors, and mentors, enabling early-stage ideas to evolve into scalable and sustainable startups.

data.title: About Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC)
data.descrtiption: The Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC) functions under CEC and serves as the faculty and student driven body promoting entrepreneurial mind-set and innovation. EDC acts as the grassroots movement of entrepreneurship within the campus.

data.title: Vision
data.descrtiption: To create a vibrant innovation ecosystem that transforms students into ethical, impactful, and scalable entrepreneurs contributing to nation-building.

data.title: Mission
points: To identify and nurture innovative ideas from students and faculty
To provide structured incubation and mentorship support
To connect start-ups with government schemes, investors, and industry
To create awareness about start-up opportunities and funding programs
To build a sustainable innovation-driven campus culture

data.title: CEO's Message
data.descrtiption: At Canara Innovation Foundation, we believe entrepreneurship is not about waiting for the perfect idea — it is about starting the journey. Our mission is to empower students to think boldly, act confidently, and build responsibly. Innovation is a continuous process, and through structured mentorship, ecosystem support, and government-backed opportunities, we help students transform ideas into impactful ventures. We are committed to creating entrepreneurs who do not just seek jobs — but create them. Let us innovate, incubate, and inspire.

data.title: Section Infin-8 Foundation
data.descrtiption: Canara Innovation Foundation has signed an MoU with Section Infin-8 Foundation to promote innovation, leadership development, and student-driven entrepreneurial initiatives. The collaboration focuses on capacity building, mentorship support, and exposure to real-world impact programs. This partnership strengthens CIF’s commitment to nurturing socially responsible and innovation-oriented entrepreneurs.

data.title: Wadhwani Foundation
data.descrtiption: Canara Innovation Foundation has signed an MoU with the Wadhwani Foundation to strengthen entrepreneurship education and student skill development. This non-commercial, philanthropic collaboration enables access to globally recognized entrepreneurial learning platforms and structured startup-readiness programs. The partnership supports faculty enablement and empowers students with practical entrepreneurial competencies.
